exposure: Monitoring and analysis of blood patch frequency
Introduction of quality improvement measures for neuraxial blocks
Use of atraumatic 26 or 27-gauge pencil-point spinal needles
outcome: Frequency of postdural puncture headaches (PDPH) requiring a blood patch
Percentage of epidural catheters placed for vaginal birth
Number of pregnant women undergoing caesarean section
Proportion of cesarean sections in spinal anesthesia
cohort: Obstetric patients at University Hospital Sveti Duh who received neuraxial blocks.
finding: The frequency of blood patch applications for postdural puncture headache was statistically significantly reduced from 6.12% before 2009 to 0.30% during the intervention period (2009-2018).
mod_finding: The percentage of placed epidural catheters for vaginal birth increased from 21% in 2009 to 38% in 2018, despite a general decline in total births and an increase in caesarean sections.
